address: # Function entry points this project verified from the ROM that the third-party
# ds-decomp configuration does not carry. Merged by tools/build_corpus.py.
# A row here is a CLAIM WITH EVIDENCE, not a guess. The evidence column says how
# the entry was established, and tools/lb_verify.py re-derives the consequence
# (ARM9 .text coverage) on every run, so a wrong row shows up as a coverage
# figure that stops making sense rather than as a silent inflation.
# These two are alternate entry points. Each is a run of the ARM XOR-swap idiom
# (eor a,a,b / eor b,a,b / eor a,a,b) that FALLS THROUGH into the function the
# config records at the next address -- so the callable code physically starts
# earlier than the recorded entry. Nothing branches into either from the
# preceding function, which rules out their being tails of it. This is the
# ordinary shape of a library helper with two entries, one of which normalises
# argument order before joining the common body.
